title: Tanker LIPSI hit by projectile in Strait of Hormuz
excerpt: UKMTO reports tanker LIPSI struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz on 4 October, engine room damaged, crew safe. Tanker reports explosions off Yemen.
x_post: Tanker struck by unknown projectile in Strait of Hormuz on 4 October, engine room damaged, crew safe, UKMTO said. Vanguard Tech identified the ship as LIPSI, per The Maritime Executive. #MaritimeSecurity #Shipping #StraitOfHormuz #UKMTO
